name: Mons Mouton (NASA VIPER Target)
description: Flat-topped mountain plateau selected by NASA for the VIPER volatiles rover; offers extended solar illumination and low-slope terrain.

name: Connecting Ridge (Artemis III)
description: High-altitude ridge linking Shackleton and de Gerlache craters; receives near-continuous sunlight at peak elevations.

name: Malapert A (CLPS IM-1 Odysseus)
description: Official touchdown site of Intuitive Machines IM-1; situated near the 5km-tall Malapert Massif with strong direct-to-Earth line of sight.

name: Faustini Rim A (Artemis III)
description: Elevated crater rim bordering a Permanently Shadowed Region (PSR) rich in surface water-ice signatures.

name: Haworth (Artemis III)
description: Ancient polar crater region characterized by severe horizon obstructions and prolonged shadow blackouts.
